stopping_rules.rule: Fixed design: 2 arms x 6 cases x (3 warmups + 20 measured rounds) = 276 invocations, each exactly 100 benchmark operations, then stop.
Attempt every fixed cell once; retain failures and never replace or extend based on observed values.

A nonzero exit, timeout, missing metric, b.N other than 100, fingerprint mismatch, binary mismatch, or failed isolation receipt makes the affected evidence invalid under the stated rule; already attempted rows remain archived.

invalidation_rules: A row is mechanically complete only when exit status is zero, b.N is 100, all four numeric metrics are present, and the case-specific correctness fingerprints are present.
Any baseline/A-A fingerprint mismatch invalidates the campaign and blocks candidate timing.
A row with a binary hash other than the pinned digest is invalid.

A row below L2 isolation, with changed affinity, throttling, nonzero steal delta, material PSI contention, or wrapper contention is invalid for wall and CPU analysis; exact fields and valid allocation counts remain reportable.
Profiled, race-instrumented, or nonregistered invocations are excluded from the measured distribution.
No failed or invalid row is replaced without a new prospective amendment.

decision_rule.text: Accept the A/A session only when all 240 measured rows and 36 warmups are attempted once, every measured row is mechanically complete, pairwise correctness fingerprints match in all 120 measured pairs, baseline/A-A median B/op and allocs/op ratios lie in [0.98,1.02] for every case, wall and CPU median ratios lie in [0.95,1.05] for every case, and each wall/CPU 95% paired bootstrap interval contains 1. Allocation and exact fields may remain reportable if only the isolation clock gate fails, but no timing claim or candidate timing proceeds from a rejected A/A session.
decision_rule.threshold: 240/240 measured rows complete; exact fingerprints pairwise equal; allocation ratios 0.98..1.02; wall and CPU ratios 0.95..1.05 with paired 95% intervals containing 1; isolation receipt valid.
decision_rule.statistic: For each case, pair baseline and A/A by round and compute A/A-over-baseline median ratios for B/op, allocs/op, wall ns/op, and CPU ns/op.
decision_rule.interval: 95% paired bootstrap over the 20 fixed measured pairs per case; exact completeness and fingerprint gates have no interval.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: A/A-over-baseline median ratio and percent difference per metric and case

graphs: paired A/A-over-baseline allocation, wall, and CPU ratios by case
